title: chore: remove the in-app AI chat

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟡 **Confidence 6/10** · needs attention Held at 6 because 44 reviewed files were not read. 1 note · tests covered · risk medium · 44 files not read Removes the in-app chat page, sheet, topbar button and palette shortcuts, keeps the investigation Chat/Transcript tabs, and gates the session routes to investigation sessions. The removal is contained and the new links and 404s are tested; one notification renders two buttons to the same page. - `buildAlertOpenUrl` replaces the chat link with the incident, rule, or `/alerts` - `/api/chat/sessions/*` and `/internal/chat/apply` 404 for non-investigation sessions - Investigation tabs now own the conversation code moved out of `page/chat` - The chat sheet, `C` shortcut and "Fix with AI" tile option are gone ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · Error-issue notifications now carry two buttons to the same page correctness · [`packages/backend/src/services/alerts/NotificationDispatcher.ts:181`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/eaf8cf32511e958f7f9d55fcd68ea3eb9c70a7c0/packages/backend/src/services/alerts/NotificationDispatcher.ts#L181) Every request through this dispatcher is an error issue or its escalation, and `request.linkUrl` is already passed as the primary link at line 211, so `chatUrl` is the very same URL. Slack, Discord, Telegram and the email template render both links, so an error-issue notification arrives with "Open in Maple" and "View alert" pointing at the identical issue page (`delivery/transports/chat.ts:41`, `packages/email/emails/alert-notification.vue:29`). Skip the secondary link when it equals the primary instead of duplicating it under an alert label. ``` In `dispatchDeliveryImpl`/the transports, render the second link only when `chatUrl !== linkUrl`, or drop `chatUrl` from the notification payload for error issues. ```
